generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; parent tables filled before children.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Populated exclusively from the parent table's primary-key values (compact + generated); never sampled from the numeric range/boundary pool; never NULL for the three FK columns of this schema.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer within the column's range rule; boundary values at listed literals plus one step on each side, clamped to the column's range rule.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Random token from a small pool of plausible names; near-variants (case flips) for listed equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_long: Random sentence-like string of 20-120 chars; near-variants for listed equality literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: 80% non-NULL from the text rule, 20% NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_text: Uniform choice among the listed enum values.
generic_sampling_rules.date_integer: Uniform integer year within the column's range; boundary values at listed literals plus one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_and_duplicate: For DISTINCT columns, allow 20-50% duplicate share; for ORDER columns, plant ties at the listed ranks.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_perturbation: Boundary literals are planted at the literal and at literal +/- one step; the perturbed value is clamped to the column's range rule so no semantic rule is violated.
generic_sampling_rules.null_planting_precedence: NULL planting runs after FK filling; it skips FK columns whose target says 'no NULL FK' and skips NOT NULL / PK columns.

supporting_evidence.chapters.Act: Sample rows show Act values 1,2,3,4,5,0; range 0-6 covers all.

supporting_evidence.works.GenreType: Sample rows show Comedy, Tragedy, History, Poem, Sonnet; enum matches.
supporting_evidence.fk_edges: Schema declares chapters.work_id references works, paragraphs.chapter_id references chapters, paragraphs.character_id references characters (implicit PK targets); dependencies list resolves each to the parent's id.

uncertainty: The exact distribution of Act/Scene values and the share of NULLs in nullable text columns are not fully specified by the statistics; the rules use the observed ranges and enum values. The duplicate and tie patterns are approximated from the atomic-operation summary. FK columns are NOT NULL per schema; _plant_nulls must skip them. Boundary perturbation must be clamped to the column range rule (Act 0-6, Scene 1-8) to avoid latent rule violations.
